title: Ben-Hadad besieges Samaria and Ahab's victory
description: Ben-Hadad of Aram besieges Samaria with thirty-two kings and demands Ahab's silver, gold, wives, and sons. Ahab refuses after counsel from the elders. A prophet promises victory from the Lord, and 232 young men who served the provincial governors lead the way. The Arameans are defeated, and Ben-Hadad flees on horseback.
